title: Re: Strike at Storeroom 1A
description: Re: Strike at Storeroom 1A — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Wally Wanka

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 1A and Return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Wally Wanka

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 1A and Return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

I'll say, those Abba Labbas sure are annoying over achievers. As soon as you take those Candy Fabricators down they pop them right back up. You don't need me to tell you that this is typical of their deplorable over achieving ways! We need to get those things off line! The fate of candy depends on it!

Get back into Storeroom 1A and destroy those Candy Fabricators. There will be Abba Labbas waiting for you, but don't falter, you have at least a four foot height advantage so you should be able to handle them. Have you tried the thing where you extend your arm all the way and put your hand on their head? That way they won't be able to hit you.

Turn-in:

The Candy Fabricators are destroyed? Excellently done, Dungeon Runner! Let me know if you want to do this again.

Objectives:

  • Destroy Candy Fabricators

Level range: 40–100
